about: Literal back-translation of the Spanish storyboard of content/zoora-ai/_engine-demo (snapshot in this folder), made 2026-11-24 by a Claude session (wave 3) for the proof run. NOT blind: this session had read the English storyboard first. Each item keeps the Spanish text it was made from, so a change to the episode shows up as stale.

title.text: Por qué la mayoría de las memecoins nuevas mueren el primer día
title.bt: Why most of the new memecoins die on the first day

s01.narration.text: La mayoría de las memecoins nuevas en Pump.fun nunca llegan al segundo día. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing]
s01.narration.bt: Most of the new memecoins on Pump.fun never reach the second day. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing]

s01.onScreen.subtitle.text: Lo que muestran los datos de lanzamiento

s02.narration.text: CoinGecko rastreó 18,67 millones de ellas. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing] El 68,67% hizo su última operación en la curva de lanzamiento el primer día. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing] Noventa días después, solo el 4,55% seguía cotizando. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing]
s02.narration.bt: CoinGecko tracked 18.67 million of them. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing] The 68.67% made its last trade/operation on the launch curve on the first day. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing] Ninety days later, only 4.55% was still trading/listed. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing]

s02.onScreen.bullets.1.text: 68,67%: última operación en curva, día uno
s02.onScreen.bullets.1.bt: 68.67%: last trade/operation on curve, day one

s03.narration.text: Así luce el primer día, en una moneda inventada. Un lanzamiento, una ráfaga de compras, luego una venta masiva, y una lenta agonía.
s03.narration.bt: This is how the first day looks, on an invented coin. A launch, a burst of purchases, then a massive sale, and a slow agony.

s04.narration.text: Antes de tocar una moneda nueva, pregúntate: ¿quién tiene el suministro? ¿Qué más lanzó su creador? ¿Y quién cobra por promocionarla?
s04.narration.bt: Before touching a new coin, ask yourself: who has the supply? What else did its creator launch? And who charges/gets paid for promoting it?

s04.onScreen.title.text: Antes de tocar una moneda nueva

s04.onScreen.steps.1.bt: What else did its creator launch?

s04.onScreen.steps.2.bt: Who charges/gets paid for promoting it?

s05.narration.text: Porque los analistas on-chain de Bubblemaps advirtieron: las billeteras secundarias se han convertido en un modelo de negocio. [src:bm-side-wallets]
s05.narration.bt: Because the on-chain analysts of Bubblemaps warned: the secondary wallets have become a business model. [src:bm-side-wallets]

s05.onScreen.quote.text: Las billeteras secundarias se han convertido en un modelo de negocio.
s05.onScreen.quote.bt: The secondary wallets have become a business model.

s06.narration.text: Si prefieres leer los datos en vez de perseguir la euforia, suscríbete.
s06.narration.bt: If you prefer to read the data instead of chasing the euphoria, subscribe.

s06.onScreen.title.text: Lee los datos, no la euforia
s06.onScreen.title.bt: Read the data, not the euphoria

s07.narration.bt: What comes next: who is really on the other side of your trade/operation?
